Ridgeview Fire: Evacuation Updates
Last updated: October 24, 2026, 1:45 PM PDT
Evacuation Warning
An Evacuation Warning is in effect for zones SON-3A and SON-3B near the Ridgeview Fire, east of Santa Rosa.
Zone SON-3A: Ridgeview Road from Highway 12 to Bennett Valley Road
Zone SON-3B: Matanzas Creek area
Leave immediately if an Evacuation Order is issued for your zone.
